title: Word chain game
what: One game among a room and an optional robot: turns, judging a move by the word book, the Hangul last-syllable and initial-sound rule, rounds and scores, said as events. Lives in src/game.rs, hangul.rs and policy.rs.

title: Word book
what: The SQLite word book a game judges by, installed out of the KKuTu word list and the NIKL dictionaries into word-chain/ko.sqlite, and a word looked up in it. Lives in src/install.rs and book.rs.
